title: Implement hybrid semantic search for entity retrieval
action: Replace graph-manager.searchEntities() token-overlap ranking with HybridSearch composition: FTS5 keyword strategy + VectorSearch semantic strategy, merged via RRF fusion. Keep FTS5 fallback for when VectorSearch is unavailable.

criteria: searchEntities returns results ranked by combined keyword + semantic similarity
Fallback to FTS5/LIKE still works when vector search unavailable

implementation: 1) In graph-manager, create HybridSearch instance with two strategies: (a) keyword strategy wrapping existing FTS5/LIKE query, (b) vector strategy using VectorSearch similarity query filtered by entity type and workspaceId. 2) Replace _rankByRelevance with HybridSearch.search() call. 3) Map HybridSearch results back to Entity objects. 4) Keep existing fallback path for environments without VectorSearch.
